official.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Economics
official.description_text:
Tampere University
is a unique, boldly future‑oriented and evolving community, and one of Finland’s most multidisciplinary universities. At Tampere University, technology, health and society come together in a distinctive way. Our research groups and projects carry out interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral research that transcends organisational boundaries. Our community is international, with members from more than 80 countries. Read more at
Tampere University (TAU) | Tampere University
.
Tampere University is inviting applications for the position of Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Economics.
Economics
at Tampere University is part of the degree program in business studies at the
Faculty of Management and Business
. We provide an internationally standardized Economics program at Bachelor, Master and PhD levels.
The person to be appointed will be part of the
Finnish Centre of Excellence in Tax Systems Research (FIT)
. FIT studies the effects and design of multiple aspects of public policy. Our research program is very broad, covering a multitude of topics related to public finance, labor, health, and environmental economics, and industrial organization. Our research utilizes empirical, experimental, and theoretical methods, together with world-class register data on individuals and firms.
Job description
We seek a highly accomplished early-career academic to conduct and organize high-quality scientific research. We encourage applications from highly promising candidates with an ambition to carry out innovative, top-quality research. We expect the postdoctoral researcher to conduct research of very high international quality aiming at top academic journals. We also expect the candidates to give research-based teaching and to actively contribute to international research collaboration.
We require
PhD degree in Economics. The PhD degree should be completed by 30.6.2027.
Potential to produce research at a high international level of excellence and ability to undertake independent scholarly activity.
We are looking for candidates who have recently completed or are close to completion of their PhD in Economics. Applicants will be reviewed based on their potential for excellence in research, teaching, and activity in the international scientific community. We emphasize innovativeness and ambition demonstrated by current and planned research, as well as international experience and research collaboration. We are interested in candidates in all fields of economics. Linkages with our current research areas are considered a benefit, and your research may include applied research topics, methodological and/or theoretical themes that complement or bring in new perspectives to our research program. The position requires fluency in English.
We offer
The postdoctoral research fellow will be hired for a fixed term of five years. The start date will be September 1, 2027, unless another date is mutually agreed. A trial period of six months applies to all our new employees.
The salary will be based on both the job requirements and the employee's personal performance in accordance with the
Finnish University Salary System
.  The typical gross salary of a Postdoctoral Research Fellow ranges from 3,900 to 4,200 EUR/month. Higher salaries may be agreed upon depending on qualifications and experience of the candidate.
We offer you the opportunity to join a dynamic, innovative, and international research community of the Finnish Centre of Excellence in Tax Systems Research, and the discipline of Economics at Tampere University.  Tampere University offers a wide range of staff benefits, such as occupational health care, flexible working hours, excellent sports facilities on campus and several restaurants and cafés on campus with staff discounts. Please read more about
working at Tampere University
.
How to apply
Please submit your application through our online recruitment system in English (link below). The closing date for applications is
13 December 2026 (at 23.59 EET / UTC+2).
The following documents should be attached to your application in PDF format:
Cover letter
Curriculum vitae
Job market paper
Other papers, if available
Research statement outlining your proposed research (max. 3 pages)
Names, positions, and contact details of two referees
Initial interviews will be conducted remotely via Zoom between December 2026 and January 2027.
For more information, please contact:
Professor and the head of discipline Kaisa Kotakorpi,
kaisa.kotakorpi@tuni.fi
For more information about the application process, please contact HR Specialist Ilona Pekuri, ilona.pekuri@tuni.fi
***
Tampereen yliopisto
on ainutlaatuinen, rohkeasti tulevaisuuteen katsova, kehittyvä yhteisö ja yksi Suomen monialaisimmista yliopistoista. Meillä tekniikka, terveys ja yhteiskunta kohtaavat toisensa ainutlaatuisella tavalla. Tutkimusryhmissämme ja -hankkeissamme tehdään monitieteistä ja -alaista tutkimusta yli organisaatiorajojen. Yhteisömme on kansainvälinen, meitä on jo yli 80 maasta. Lue lisää
Tampereen yliopisto (TAU) | Tampereen yliopisto
.
Haemme nyt taloustieteen tutkijatohtoria viiden vuoden määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Tehtävässä toivottu aloitusajankohta on 1.9.2027 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan.
Tehtävänkuvaus
Etsimme tehtävään erittäin motivoitunutta ja menestynyttä uransa alkuvaiheessa olevaa tutkijatohtoria. Tutkijatohtorin pääasiallisena tehtävänä on tehdä ja organisoida laadukasta tieteellistä tutkimusta. Toivomme hakemuksia erityisesti lupaavilta hakijoilta, joilla on vahvaa potentiaalia menestyä taloustieteen kansainvälisessä tiedeyhteisössä. Tehtävä sijoittuu Verotutkimuksen huippuyksikköön (FIT), mutta tehtävän erikoisalaa ei ole rajattu. Odotamme tutkijatohtorin tekevän tutkimusta, joiden tavoitteena on julkaisut parhaissa kansainvälisissä taloustieteen journaaleissa. Edellytämme hakijoilta myös tutkimuslähtöistä opetusta ja aktiivista osallistumista kansalliseen ja kansainväliseen tutkimusyhteistyöhön.
Hakuohjeet
Lue tarkemmat tiedot tehtävästä ja hakuohjeet yllä olevasta englanninkielisestä ilmoituksesta.
Jätäthän hakemuksesi yliopiston sähköisellä hakulomakkeella englanniksi (linkki löytyy tämän ilmoituksen alta).
Hakuaika tehtävään päättyy
13.12.2026 klo 23.59.
Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa:
Professori ja huippuyksikön johtaja Kaisa Kotakorpi,
kaisa.kotakorpi@tuni.fi
Lisätietoja hakuprosessista antaa HR asiantuntija Ilona Pekuri, ilona.pekuri@tuni.fi

ai.summary: Postdoctoral research position in economics at Tampere University's Finnish Centre of Excellence in Tax Systems Research (FIT), focusing on public finance, labor, health, environmental economics, and industrial organization using empirical, experimental, and theoretical methods with register data.

thematic_fit.rationale: The position is fundamentally rooted in economics and public policy research. The researcher's entire background is in human-centred immersive systems, spatial cognition, and collaborative XR design. No thematic overlap exists with tax systems, public finance, labor economics, or environmental policy. The mention of 'experimental methods' does not bridge this gap—the experimental designs, outcomes, and knowledge domains are entirely distinct.

methodological_fit.rationale: While both domains use empirical methods, the methodological fit is superficial. The researcher has intermediate-level quantitative research and experimental design skills applied to user studies in XR contexts. Economics postdocs require advanced econometric and statistical modeling (register-data analysis, policy evaluation frameworks). The researcher has beginner-level statistics with no mixed-effects modelling. The research cultures, analytical traditions, and technical toolkits are fundamentally misaligned.

growth_value.rationale: This position offers no meaningful closure of capability gaps aligned with the researcher's target identity. It would require abandoning human-centred XR/HCI research entirely. The researcher would gain no transferable skills toward immersive systems, spatial learning, or collaborative design research.

strategic_value.rationale: Tampere University is a strong institution and located in the researcher's preferred geography (Finland). However, the position is in the wrong discipline entirely. FIT's research program does not intersect with HCI or immersive systems. A postdoc at this career stage, if pursued, would be a career pivot away from the stated target identity, not a strategic step toward doctoral and postdoctoral roles in human-centred XR research.

eligibility_flags: Requires completed PhD in Economics by 30.6.2027; researcher holds MSc by Research (in progress), not PhD
Position requires demonstrated research excellence in economics discipline; researcher has no economics background or publications
Postdoctoral position typically requires completed PhD; researcher is still at thesis stage
risks: Researcher is ineligible: MSc (in progress) does not meet PhD requirement
Complete disciplinary mismatch would set back doctoral candidacy timeline and research trajectory
No supervisory or methodological continuity with human-centred XR research community
